About.Title: کے بارے میں
About.Headline: Create, share, and remix p5.js sketches with the p5.js Editor.
About.IntroDescription1: p5.js is a free, open-source JavaScript library for learning to code and make art. Using the p5.js Editor, you can create, share, and remix p5.js sketches without needing to download or configure anything.
About.IntroDescription2: We believe software the tools to learn it, should be as open and inclusive as possible. You can support this work by making a donation to the Processing Foundation, the organization that supports p5.js. Your donation supports software development for p5.js, education resources like code examples and tutorials, fellowships, and community events.

LinkDescriptions.Home: Learn more about p5.js and our community.
LinkDescriptions.Examples: Explore the possibilities of p5.js with short examples.
LinkDescriptions.CodeOfConduct: Read our Community Statement and Code of Conduct.
LinkDescriptions.Libraries: Expand the possibilities of p5.js with community-created libraries.
LinkDescriptions.Reference: Find easy explanations for every piece of p5.js code.
LinkDescriptions.Donate: Support this work with a donation to the Processing Foundation.
LinkDescriptions.Contribute: Contribute to the open-source p5.js Editor on Github.
LinkDescriptions.Report: Report broken or incorrect behavior with the p5.js Editor.
LinkDescriptions.Forum: Ask questions, share sketches, and get help from the p5.js community.
LinkDescriptions.Discord: Chat with the p5.js community and get quick help.
